title: Decoding a list of child circuits
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number and let $ds$ be a list of Boolean circuit trees on $n$ variables. Suppose each tree $d$ in $ds$ can be read back from its encoding whenever the available fuel is at least the encoding length, leaving any appended remainder unchanged. Then, for every fuel and remainder, if the encoding of the whole child list has length at most the fuel, reading that encoding followed by the remainder returns exactly $ds$ and the unchanged remainder.
